adjudication.evidence: Original N/E/U show a sustained ~10 MAD upward shift in N and U beginning near index 656, with E showing a smaller but coherent offset; the signal returns sharply near index 671–672, forming a closed platform. P2 (658–660) is too short to represent the full temporary platform and overlaps P1; interior points between 658–670 remain elevated relative to pre-656 baseline, confirming persistence. Hypothesis P1 subtraction restores continuity across all axes, while P2 subtraction leaves residual offsets. No independent permanent step is evident within the interval; physical motion outside remains smooth.
